T16 built. All work is in the three owned files.

**Exported API**

`lib/windowRegistry.ts` (new) — `WINDOW_REGISTRY_KEY='dc.windows.v1'`, `HEARTBEAT_MS=5000`, `STALE_MS=15000`, `WindowRegistryEntry{label,vaults,ts}`, `thisWindowLabel(): Promise<string>` (cached; `''` off-desktop/ACL-denied), `publishOpenVaults(vaults)`, `releaseWindow()`, `findWindowForVault(vault): string|null` (registry-only, skips empty labels and this window's own row), `resolveLiveWindowForVault(vault): Promise<string|null>` (registry ∩ `WebviewWindow.getAll()`, null off-desktop, no fallback). Every `localStorage` access try/caught; malformed rows dropped on read; unlocked write races degrade to one lost heartbeat (a third of `STALE_MS`), never a throw or a torn blob.
`lib/desktop.ts` — added `focusWindow(label): Promise<boolean>`. `vaultWindowLabel`, `openVaultWindow`, `openChecklistWindow`, `openLauncherHome`, `goToProject` untouched.
`lib/checklistBridge.ts` — submit now resolves a corroborated label and returns `false` when it can't; no derived label anywhere in the file.

**emitTo/listen census** (`dashboard/src` + `desktop/src-tauri/src`) — targeted: only `checklistBridge.ts` submit (`:71`, was the one break, now fixed) and the ack (`checklistWindowLabel(vault,id)` — injective over both parts, names a window hosting exactly one checklist, payload is `{checklistId,ok}` with no secret → correct as-is). Broadcast, unaffected: `sleepy.ts:98,109,121,205`, `SleepyPerch.tsx:53`, Rust `listen_any` ×4 + `app.emit("sleepy:shown")`. `savedViews.ts:81 emit()` is local pub-sub, not Tauri.

**No other targeted event is left mis-addressed.** The ack is the only other `emitTo` and its label doesn't encode "one vault per window".

**Checks** — 1 PASS (zero `vaultWindowLabel` matches; I rewrote my own comments to describe it without the identifier so the grep stays usable as a tripwire). 2 PASS (zero tsc errors in my three files). 3 PASS (39/39 green; no test exercises the submit path, so none needed updating). 4 **FAIL, not mine**: `npm run build` is gated by `tsc -b`, which fails on `AgentSurface.tsx`/`SettingsPage.tsx`/`BrainSyncControl.tsx` (`chatPermissionMode`, `brainSyncPrefs` arity — T12's split, awaiting T11) and `ProjectInstance.tsx` (`ShellProps` — T10/T6). None import my modules; `npx vite build` bundles clean in 34s, so my code is bundle-clean. 5 PASS for my scope (117 other dirty files belong to the concurrent lanes).

One thing worth recording for T20: I verified `WebviewWindow.getAll()` invokes `plugin:window|get_all_windows`, whose permission `core:window:allow-get-all-windows` ships inside `core:default` — granted in **both** `capabilities/default.json` and the narrow `capabilities/checklist.json`. Corroboration therefore works from the checklist window with no capability change; had it not, fail-closed would have meant permanently-broken submits.
